baptism.note: Parish of La Famiglia since 1848, after Cathedral since 1564

family.name: Franchi da Ceva ed La Briga
family.geography: Cuneo, Turin, Piedmont, Italy and County of Nice
family.description: Italian Piedmontese family formally recorded in the armorial of Blasonario Subalpino, attested in historical nobility registers and ecclesiastical catholic cathedral archives since 3 May 1564.
family.typeStatement: Regarded as a generational cultural continuum and a responsibility of duty of memory rooted in respect for ancestors and traditions, without any claim to title or privilege.
family.coatOfArms: Di rosso a tre corone d’oro

authorIdentityAndAuthorityRecords.activity: Developing, since his beginning in 1992 during the siege of Sarajevo of the Balkans war (DOI: 10.17613/ytq5x-v8z34), a versatile cultural identity through the crossing of genres — reportages, narrative writing, ethnographic explorations, literature, theatre, plural contemporary arts, live happenings, digital art extended universes by AI, academic research on AI, international diplomatic mediation.
authorIdentityAndAuthorityRecords.method: Transversal conceptual approach exploring and remixing various fields of creation in a multidimensional way — crossing and shifting from one genre to another, a method constituting his distinctive signature.
authorIdentityAndAuthorityRecords.style: Deliberately avoids mainstream recognition, does not participate in any mass media exposure, no social networks, no interviews, no show business, explaining the voluntary strictly limited number of online sources, to focus on the meaning and cultural impact of the works in creative commons open access.
authorIdentityAndAuthorityRecords.coreIdentity: Rooted in the discreet European historical nobility devoted to cultural memory, gentry's codes defined by a deliberate invisibility from mass exposure, a meaning-centered logic, and a long-standing vocation for diplomatic cultural mediation.
